\section{Discussion}\label{sec:discussion}

The failure traces to an incompatibility between teacher-forcing and GAR-family auxiliary losses, not to the gating architecture. This has implications beyond ThreadGate: any auxiliary attention objective paired with teacher forcing, whether per-head gating \citep{qiu2025gated}, split-softmax \citep{li2024measuring}, or residual scaling \citep{bachlechner2021rezero}, should face the same exposure bias barrier when targeting distributional properties of the attention pattern rather than the prediction itself.

\paragraph{Why NTP self-recovers but GAR does not.} NTP self-recovers because the task (predict one token from a prefix) is identical at training and inference; exposure bias shifts the prefix distribution but preserves the prediction task \citep{he2019exposure}. GAR optimizes a \emph{global property of the prefix}, attention allocation to goal tokens, that has no autoregressive counterpart: the model receives no feedback on attention distributions during generation, so the training signal is specific to teacher-forced prefixes. Per-head analysis confirms this selectivity: heads with higher TF GAR shift most under AR generation ($r$\,=\,0.743; Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix-kl}).

\paragraph{Downstream effects.} Instruction retention ($\beta$\,=\,3) shows late-turn compliance rising from 75.9\% to 87.0\% (+11.1\,pp, McNemar $p$\,=\,0.077; GAR correlation $r$\,=\,0.200, $p$\,=\,0.007). Content constraints benefit most (+23.8\,pp), while format constraints show zero change, consistent with GAR targeting cross-turn semantic coherence rather than locally-verifiable procedural rules (Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix-ir}).

\paragraph{SS and steering as substitutes.} SS provides training-time mitigation with no inference cost; steering provides inference-time recovery with PPL cost. At high $\beta$ the two converge: they are substitutes, not complements ($\beta$\,=\,5: SS GAR\,=\,$0.717\pm0.001$ vs.\ TG\,=\,0.727; Figure~\ref{fig:steering-recovery}). SS is preferable when inference budgets are tight, steering when retraining is infeasible.

\section{Limitations}\label{sec:limitations}

Our findings are demonstrated on two model families (Qwen-2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B), one dataset (UltraChat, 8K conversations), and most configurations use a single seed (scheduled sampling validated on three seeds; \S\ref{subsec:ss}); quality assessment relies on PPL rather than comprehensive benchmarks \citep{hendrycks2021measuring,lin2022truthfulqa}. We test only one auxiliary loss family (GAR with MSE target $\tau$\,=\,0.5); head-specific or layer-specific losses may exhibit different sensitivity to exposure bias. The PCGrad exclusion addresses gradient direction conflict only; magnitude imbalance \citep{chen2018gradnorm} and Nash equilibrium approaches \citep{navon2022nash} remain untested.

3	Attention to system-prompt goals decays 70.8\% over five conversation turns on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, despite residual stream probes confirming that goal representations persist (area under the curve, AUC\,=\,0.98; \citealp{dongre2026attention}). ## 5. Key Selling Points

**SP1 (核心卖点): Exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的首个实证刻画。** 8×–27× training-inference GAR-ours gap（Qwen 7.8×, Llama 27× median）提供了 teacher-forcing distribution shift 如何摧毁 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的实证证据。训练时模型在 gold context 上优化 attention pattern，推理时在自身生成的 context 上条件化——两者分布不同导致 attention pattern 不迁移。虽然 exposure bias 概念本身已知 (Bengio et al. 2015)，且 sequence generation 中有量化先例 (Ranzato et al. 2016, Wiseman & Rush 2016)，但此前无人刻画其对 auxiliary attention loss 的具体影响。我们的 8×–27× gap 测量展示了这种脆弱性在 attention steering 场景下的严重程度。**注意：(1) claim scope 严格限于 lightweight residual gating + GAR auxiliary loss 的实测范围，不泛化到所有 attention steering 方法。(2) gap 在 GAR-ours（last token only, summary-position attention）上测得（TF 0.50 vs AR 0.064 Qwen / 0.018 Llama）；GAR-Dongre（all response tokens）在两种分布上均低，无 gap——表明 exposure bias 选择性影响 summary-position attention pattern，这一差异本身有分析价值。**

**SP2: NTP-GAR 梯度动力学 + PCGrad 因果排除（gradient conflict is inconsequential）。** 观察到 67-79% 的层 NTP-GAR 梯度方向冲突（cos_sim<0）+ NTP 幅度 3-15x 压制 GAR（mag_ratio 7.5→14.7x）。**PCGrad 消融（D028）因果排除方向冲突**：投影后 cos_sim 围绕 0 震荡（range -0.151 to +0.091），L_GAR 坍塌轨迹不变。**推理端确认（IID same-protocol）**: v9 IID PPL = 2.780 vs v7 = 2.784（差 0.004，无改善）; v9 GAR-ours = 0.0151 vs v7 = 0.0157（差 <0.1pp）——**PCGrad 消除方向冲突后所有可观测指标均无变化**（GAR、PPL、NTP 均 ≈ v7）。方向冲突虽然可测量存在于 v7 中，但对训练和推理结果无任何因果影响——7.5–14.7× NTP 幅度主导使方向冲突完全无关紧要（inconsequential）。**⚠️ M017: 此前 "PPL -46%" 和 "selective dissociation" 论述为跨协议对比伪影（model-gen PPL 1.50 vs IID PPL 2.78），已撤回。** **精确 claim scope**: gradient direction conflict is **neither necessary nor sufficient** for the 8×–27× GAR gap; exposure bias alone is sufficient。NOT necessary: 移除冲突→gap仍在; NOT sufficient: v7有冲突但L_GAR训练时收敛; Exposure bias is sufficient: 训练≠推理分布→GAR泛化失败。**Gate 行为额外 insight**: v9 gate dynamic range 比 v7 更宽 (L15 range 0.33 vs v7 0.21)——PCGrad 给 gate 更大自由度，但 gate 用该自由度更激进地优化 NTP 而非 GAR，说明优化景观固有偏好语言建模目标。

**SP3: Principled 设计动机 + 系统性探索。** Dongre 发现 goal info 在 residual stream 持续存在 (probe AUC=0.98)，residual gating 是最直接的架构响应。v1-v7 覆盖 4 种核心 loss 设计 across 7 training configurations，MSE+gate_div 是唯一训练收敛方案。四路消融严格隔离贡献: TG (learned gate + GAR loss) / UG (uniform gate + GAR loss) / LoRA-only (gate=1.0 fixed + GAR loss, 无 gating 机制) / Base。注意：三个 fine-tuned 变体均使用 GAR loss，消融测试的是 gating 机制的增量贡献，而非 GAR loss 本身的效果。
